chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from al-Barqī, who raised it to Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
If a man approaches a woman in her anus and does not emit, then there is no ghusl (ritual bath) upon either of them. But if he emits, then ghusl is upon him, and there is no ghusl upon her.

key_terms.غُسْلَ: the ritual bath required after janabah

ai.seo_question: When is ghusl required in this form of intercourse according to the hadith of Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning ghusl in a specific form of intercourse. It states that ghusl is not required for either party if no emission occurs, but if the man emits, ghusl becomes obligatory upon him alone and not upon the woman.
